title: lazima nisifikirie kuwa niko sahihi, kwa sababu hapo ndipo mpambano wa madaraka unapoanza

text.I learned this from a book called \"The: Nilijifunza hili kutoka kwa kitabu kiitwacho "The Courage to Be Disliked."
text.This is something I always want to keep: Hili ni jambo ambalo ninataka kukumbuka kila wakati.
